title: Salvation by Grace Alone
definition: Salvation by Grace Alone teaches that sinners are saved by God's unearned favor, not by human works, worthiness, or achievement.
summary: Salvation by Grace Alone teaches that God's undeserved favor is the source of every part of salvation.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the gift of God, and through Him salvation is received as mercy rather than wages.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Grace alone means salvation begins, continues, and is completed by God's mercy toward the undeserving. Human effort does not create grace or add merit to it. This doctrine magnifies God's kindness and keeps the sinner's hope anchored outside himself.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because even religious people can smuggle self-credit into salvation. Grace alone humbles the proud, comforts the broken, and keeps the Church from presenting Christianity as a ladder to climb. It makes Christ the only boast of the redeemed.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Confess where you are tempted to measure God's love by your performance. Serve and obey from grace, not for grace. Speak to weary people as though grace really is for the undeserving.
